articles.title: Figma co-founder Dylan Field thinks MCP is not a perfect protocol
articles.summary: Figma said it plans to support as many standards as possible without exposing all of its data

articles.title: SpaceX alum’s aviation startup, Reliable Robotics, lands $115M, topping $1B valuation
articles.summary: Reliable Robotics extended its Series D round with $115 million in equity and $25 million in debt.

articles.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
articles.summary: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.

articles.title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving
articles.summary: Eka Robotics may be the first robotic arm that is actually good at picking a wide range of objects up, and it is so smooth and human-like, it is wowing the industry.

articles.title: Inspired Capital closes $450M fourth fund as New York pushes back on Silicon Valley’s gravitational pull
articles.summary: The raise comes as venture dollars pile up on the West Coast.

articles.title: Spotify launches paid podcast memberships with perks beyond bonus content
articles.summary: Spotify's new paid memberships let podcasters offer fans exclusive perks, including ad-free listening, early access, and bonus content, while keeping 90% of the revenue.

articles.title: Oura adds new fitness metrics to show how workouts impact your body
articles.summary: While Oura has largely dominated the smart ring market for years, rivals like RingConn and Ultrahuman are emerging to dethrone it, putting pressure on the company to keep innovating. By launching more advanced workout metrics, Oura is looking to differentiate itself from competitors as the smart ring market gets more crowded.

articles.title: Yelp can now call on your behalf to check wait times at a restaurant
articles.summary: Yelp is embedding numerous new AI features into its app that can do everything from call to check on restaurant wait times to create personalized recommendations that remember your preferences.

articles.title: Otter.ai raises $320 million from General Catalyst’s growth fund for its meeting tool
articles.summary: Meeting note-taking tool Otter.ai announced on Tuesday that it has raised $320 million from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund (CVF), which provides capital to startups without diluting equity and gets returns on the results of marketing spend. Otter.ai said that it will use these funds for enterprise growth, go-to-market strategy, international expansion, and product innovation. […]

articles.title: Blackwall quadruples valuation to $2.2B as websites wrangle an increasingly crowded internet
articles.summary: Blackwall has raised $100M at a $2.2B valuation to continue building security and filtering tools that help websites grapple with growing bot and AI traffic.

articles.title: Walmart’s Flipkart is quietly building a food delivery challenger in India
articles.summary: Flipkart has expanded access to its food-delivery service to thousands of employees ahead of its public launch.

articles.title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
articles.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.

articles.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
articles.summary: If the deal goes through, it would be the latest in a long string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.

articles.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
articles.summary: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the potential harms of their technology.

articles.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
articles.summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

articles.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
articles.summary: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

articles.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
articles.summary: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

articles.title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
articles.summary: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

articles.title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
articles.summary: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

articles.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
